content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a free web hosting service that allows users to host custom domains and static websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, this means they can host their digital product stores, including ebooks, courses, and templates, without incurring any hosting costs. By using GitHub Pages, creators can eliminate the need for third-party payment processors like Gumroad or Payhip, which charge up to 10% on every sale. This allows creators to retain more of their revenue and maintain full control over their digital commerce infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

When a customer purchases a digital product from a GitHub Pages-hosted store, the payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway that charges only 0.5% on every sale. The payment is then verified on-chain, and the digital product is automatically delivered to the customer's email address using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This seamless payment and delivery process eliminates the need for third-party intermediaries, ensuring that creators maintain full control over their digital commerce infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators who want to sell their digital products online without relying on third-party payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. By using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, creators can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows them to retain more of their revenue and maintain full control over their infrastructure. This is particularly important for creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted.
You can host your digital product store on GitHub Pages for free, eliminating the need for third-party payment processors and retaining up to 99.5% of your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack on GitHub Pages today, follow these steps: First, create a GitHub repository and set up a custom domain; next, install the necessary dependencies, including Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive; then, configure the payment processing and file delivery; finally, test and launch your digital product store. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, making it easy to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.

The answer is, you can use GitHub Pages for free digital product store hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing, eliminating the need for third-party payment processors and retaining up to 99.5% of your revenue. By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, you can create a seamless payment and delivery process that maintains full control over your digital commerce infrastructure.
By using NOWPayments, you can automate the payment verification and delivery process, ensuring a seamless customer experience.
